title: Surreal Dreamscape Vision
description: A surreal psychedelic scene features four stylized female profiles with intricate mechanical and floral headdresses in the foreground. A large ornate black phoenix with dripping patterns flies across a starry teal and purple sky containing a crescent moon, floating mechanical figures, and brain-like orbs above a distorted cityscape.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic artwork showing four overlapping female profiles facing right with highly detailed ornate headdresses made of gears flowers and mechanical parts. A large ornate black phoenix with intricate golden patterns and dripping effects flies across a starry teal sky with purple clouds and a large crescent moon. Floating bubbles contain miniature cities mechanical figures and brain-like orbs. Distorted city buildings and checkerboard patterns appear in the misty background.
